privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Ngarsa Digital collects, uses, and protects your information when you use this website or work with us.

sections.heading: Data We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly through our contact form, such as your name, email address, and message content. We also collect limited technical data automatically, including browser type, pages visited, and referral source.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to respond to inquiries, prepare project proposals, deliver our services, and communicate about ongoing work. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: Cookies & Analytics
sections.body: This website uses Google Tag Manager and related analytics tools to understand how visitors use the site. You can disable cookies in your browser settings at any time without losing access to site content.

sections.heading: Data Sharing
sections.body: We only share personal data with service providers strictly necessary to operate our business (such as email delivery), or when required by Indonesian law.

sections.heading: Data Security & Retention
sections.body: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data. Project and inquiry data is retained only as long as needed for the purposes described above.

sections.heading: Your Rights & Contact
sections.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time by emailing hello@ngarsa.com.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.description: The terms that govern the use of this website and the services provided by Ngarsa Digital.

sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing this website or engaging Ngarsa Digital for services, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: Our Services
sections.body: Ngarsa Digital provides web development, design & branding, SEO & analytics, and marketing technology services. The specific scope, timeline, and fees for each project are defined in a written proposal or agreement.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property

sections.heading: Payments
sections.body: Payment terms, schedules, and currencies are defined per project agreement. Work may be paused if invoices remain overdue beyond the agreed grace period.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: We deliver our services with professional care but do not guarantee specific business outcomes such as search rankings or revenue. Our liability is limited to the fees paid for the relevant project.

sections.heading: Governing Law & Contact
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia. Questions? Contact us at hello@ngarsa.com.

faq.q: Do we own the full source code once the project is finished?
faq.a: Yes, 100%. Upon final delivery and sign-off, all repository rights, design assets, and production deployment credentials are fully transferred to you with zero vendor lock-in.

faq.q: How do you ensure fast page speeds with rich interactive visuals?
faq.a: We implement route-level code splitting, static site generation (SSG), edge caching, and lightweight WebGL shaders that only render when visible in the viewport.

faq.q: Can you integrate with our existing backend or database?
faq.a: Yes. Whether you use PostgreSQL, Supabase, Laravel, Firebase, or custom GraphQL/REST APIs, we build resilient, typed integration layers.

faq.q: How quickly will we see results from technical SEO improvements?
faq.a: Crawl budget optimizations and technical indexation fixes typically show measurable search console improvements within 2–4 weeks; competitive keyword rank gains consolidate over 60–90 days.

faq.q: Why is server-side tracking superior to standard client-side analytics?
faq.a: Standard browser tags lose between 20% to 35% of event data due to browser tracking protection and ad-blockers. Server-side tracking routes data through your own custom domain, guaranteeing data fidelity and faster page speeds.

faq.q: Do you touch our codebase directly to implement fixes?
faq.a: Yes. Unlike agencies that just hand over PDF reports, our engineers can directly commit optimizations, structured data schemas, and metadata fixes to your repository.
